# BILL-USD-001 linked to the money that left the USD bank and was parked in
# the CAD account.
#
# The mirror of a_payment_giving_the_parked_split.txt. The settlement is USD
# throughout — USD bill, USD payable, USD bank — so `amount: 100` is the
# payment and no rate is stated.
#
# What this fixture produces: the transaction becomes
#   Assets:Bank:USD                 -100.00 USD
#   Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD +100.00 USD   in the bill's lot
# quoted in USD, with no CAD left in it. The payable side is positive where an
# invoice's receivable is negative, which is the sign a bill settlement has.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "5c6d7e8f9001122334455667788a9bac"
    txn_split_guid: "7e8f9001122334455667788a9bacbdce"
